.openthrottle/config.yml.content:
schema: openthrottle.config/v2
pipeline: core/review
engine: codex
commands:
  test: npm test

.openthrottle/skills/unused/SKILL.md.content:
---
name: unused
description: This unrelated skill is not selected.
---

# Unused

.openthrottle/evals/unused/eval.yml.content:
schema: openthrottle.eval-definition/v1
id: unused
evaluator: core/action-outcome@1
result:
  schema: openthrottle.semantic-result-schema/v1
  id: unused
  outcomes: [success]
  payload:
    summary: {type: string, required: true, max_length: 100}

.openthrottle/agents/core/reviewer/instr.content: Review the sealed subject and report only evidence-backed findings.

.openthrottle/pipelines/core/review/pipe.content:
schema: openthrottle.pipeline-definition/v1
id: core/review
version: 1
entry: review
stages:
  - id: review
    kind: agent
    agent_id: core/reviewer
    repository_authority: inspect
    skills: [core/review-change]
    entry_skill: core/review-change
    eval: core/review-result
    loop:
      over: findings
      max_parallel: 2
      max_rounds: 2
      file: loops/review-cycle.yml
    on:
      success: {to: finalize}
      needs_human: {terminal: needs_human}
  - id: finalize
    kind: command
    command: test
    on:
      success: {terminal: completed}

.openthrottle/skills/core/review-change/.content:
---
name: review-change
description: Review a change and report actionable findings.
metadata:
  audience: coding-agent
---

# Review change

Read [the rubric](references/rubric.md) when reviewing.

.openthrottle/evals/core/review-result/e.content:
schema: openthrottle.eval-definition/v1
id: core/review-result
evaluator: core/review-outcome@1
result:
  schema: openthrottle.semantic-result-schema/v1
  id: core/review-result
  outcomes: [success, needs_human]
  payload:
    summary:
      type: string
      required: true
      max_length: 4000
      normalize: string-array-to-newlines/v1
    findings: {type: json, required: true}
